An ANCOVA of the change from baseline: a table plan from the template ancova

Source: R/tpl_ancova.R
tpl_ancova.Rd

A parameter's change from baseline (CHG) at one visit, by an analysis of covariance: <response> ~ <by> + <covariates> (CHG ~ TRT01A + BASE), a linear model. Each arm's n and LS mean (SE, 95% CI), and the difference in LS means of each other arm minus the reference arm (SE, 95% CI, p-value) in that arm's column, from cardx's ard_emmeans_emmeans() and ard_emmeans_contrast() (emmeans). The reference arm is ref, else the last arm in the code list's order; the program says which (a message). The p-value is written as the program's fmt_pvalue() writes it (<0.001, else 3 decimals).

Usage

tpl_ancova(ard, population, ..., codelists = NULL)

Arguments

ard

The normalized ARD's source: the study ARD's rows of this report.

population

The analysis set's id ("SAF").

...

The template's other parameters: data, param, visit (required), by, response, covariates, where, ref.

codelists

The report's code lists, for the order and labels of values; NULL takes the ARD's.

Value

A rtfreporter::table_plan().

Examples

x <- tfl_template_expand("ancova", list(population = "SAF", data = "ADVS",
                         param = "SYSBP", visit = "CYCLE 2 DAY 1"))
x$ard$analyses[[2]]$args
#> [1] "formula = CHG ~ TRT01A + BASE, method = \"lm\""
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "tfl_r"
#> attr(,"tag")
#> [1] "!r"
